Welcome to Fara Beauty Lounge. Our bright Bayview salon is a place to settle in, feel at ease and enjoy hair and beauty care shaped around you.

From a precision cut to beautifully blended colour, we begin by listening. Your hair, your routine and your ideas guide every appointment.

With over 25 years of experience, our master stylist brings care and artistry to every visit. Come in for a refresh. Leave feeling your best.
